listings.title: Emerson, Lake & Palmer - Tarkus (LP, Album, PR )
Emerson, Lake & Palmer - Tarkus (LP, Album, PR )
The Beatles - Something New (LP, Album, Los)
listings.comment: Disc has many very light scratches, but still plays great!  Front and back covers look excellent, but sleeve as significant spine wear, as slick in middle (mostly clear of writing) is peeling. Bottom edge has 2" split in middle, brown cardboard exposed as white border gloss was removed by tape.
